finding: Trusted migration repair depends on an intermittently available Supavisor session transport. A failed read before mutation is safe to retry, while a failed read after a possibly successful repair must be resumable without blindly repeating the provider mutation.
rule: Retry only read-only provider observations; never automatically retry the migration repair mutation. Accept only exact four-version drift or zero drift before mutation, and always require zero drift afterward.
prevention: bounded retry around supabase migration list only
